result: Exact rmcp-v3.1.4 source establishes that RoleServer::Not is ServerNotification; Peer<R>::send_notification accepts R::Not and enqueues it as PeerSinkMessage::Notification without the SubscriptionSink task-status guard; TaskStatusNotification is Notification<TaskStatusNotificationMethod, TaskStatusNotificationParams>; and Notification serialization reads NotificationMetaObject from Extensions and serializes it into params._meta, merging with any params-level _meta. Therefore a direct stock Peer<RoleServer>::send_notification(ServerNotification::TaskStatusNotification(...)) path can carry arbitrary NotificationMetaObject keys to wire params._meta. This is outside SubscriptionSink/listen, whose task-status branch remains explicitly unsupported.
scope_guard: Exact positive scope is modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk release commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, crates/rmcp/src/service.rs Peer::send_notification enqueue behavior, crates/rmcp/src/service/server.rs RoleServer::Not and SubscriptionSink distinction, crates/rmcp/src/model.rs TaskStatusNotification alias, and crates/rmcp/src/model/serde_impl.rs NotificationMetaObject-to-params._meta serialization. No runtime transport integration test was executed; no claim is made that subscriptions/listen supports task notifications or that the direct path supplies durability, idempotency, restart redrive, or exactly-once effects.
